rubric.role_summary: Lead events and communications for a research institute, owning convenings, external communications, and related operations.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Lead events and communications for a research institute, owning convenings, external communications, and related operations.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience planning and executing events or convenings.
- Experience in written communications or editorial work.
- Experience directing communications work.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Demonstrated ability to design and execute convenings end-to-end, including event logistics.
- Ability to draft written communications and provide substantive editorial direction.
- Experience directing communications work and managing external contracts end-to-end across writing, design, web, video, and social.
- Experience building systems, playbooks, vendor relationships, and budgets that allow programming to scale.
- Track record of working closely with technical or research-driven people.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
